description: Templates are named by the NEED they answer (need, asks, tags), each with urls.png (show it to your human) and `columns`: the column ids your data must supply. Pass q with what the person asked for — "map of brazil's states", "ranked bars with flags", "change between two years" — and the list comes back ranked; take the first. Then create_asset with template: <id> and your data — the whole design comes along. Any chart id you were shown works as a template too, not only these.

limit.description: At most this many, best first (default 20)

q.description: What is needed, in the person's words

tags.description: Comma-separated tags every result must carry, e.g. map,united-states

name: list_templates
title: Templates by need — search, then start a chart from the best match
